description: Verifies the lock-free single-producer single-consumer ring buffer: capacity, ordering, wrap-around and an integrity check over half a million elements transferred between two threads.

checks.label: the capacity equals the template parameter
fifteen elements fit in a queue of capacity sixteen
the size reflects the pushed elements
elements are popped in first-in first-out order
the queue is empty after popping every element
repeated fill and drain cycles preserve order across index wrap-around
no element is lost, duplicated or reordered across threads
the sum of consumed elements matches the arithmetic series
the queue is empty after the transfer
